match_note: This is the Bow branch (397-399 Mile End Road, E3 4PB) of the Keatons group, which opened its first office in Bow in 1998. I chose it because you gave Bow, east London. Rightmove lists the Bow office's postcode as E3 4PB, and the group's own website lists the same office.
main_area: Bow, Tower Hamlets (E1, E2, E3, E14)

out_of_hours_phone_cover.detail: The agency's website says offices are contactable 8am to 8pm seven days a week. I found no page describing out-of-hours call answering or a maintenance line. Third-party listings (Yelp, getagent) show shorter hours of 09:00-19:00 Mon-Thu, 09:00-18:00 Fri, 09:00-17:00 Sat and closed Sun, which conflicts with the website. Trustpilot's company details say 'Open 24/7', but that does not say calls are answered.
